metas.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy Tags:Isekai/Male Protagonist/Medieval/Monster Boy/Monster Girl/Magic/Kingdom Management/Dragons/Coastal/Agender/Demons/Shounen/Ships/Ninja/Femboy Fresh off celebrating Tempest’s founding festival, Rimuru and his companions are summoned to the Sorcerous Dynasty of Thalion, a nation of elves, by its influential empress, Elmesia. But their well-earned rest at her private resort island is cut short when a mysterious girl named Yura shows up, kicking off a new adventure on the endless azure sea..

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie
metas.description:
Genres: Comedy, Romance, Slice of Life
Tags:Heterosexual/Coming of Age/Female Protagonist/Male Protagonist/Primarily Teen Cast/School/Tsundere/Food/Shounen/Chuunibyou
A re-edit of both anime seasons featuring newly added footage and will depict the story of Ichikawa and Yamada after the events of the TV series.

metas.name: ALL YOU NEED IS KILL
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Sci-Fi, Supernatural, Thriller Tags:Aliens/Time Loop/CGI/War/Gore/Survival/Robots/Female Protagonist/Full CGI/Cosmic Horror/POV/Male Protagonist/Heterosexual After an unidentified plant from outer space invasion, Rita finds herself trapped in a time loop, forced to relive the same day over and over again. With each loop, she learns. She fights. Her memories and experiences sharpen her skills, turning her into a formidable warrior. Yet, the endless cycle of death and solitude begins to wear her down. Then, she meets Keiji. "I've been repeating this day too," he says. Two lost souls, trapped in an endless war. Could their meeting change fate?

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime)

Note: The film received an early premiere at the 2025 Annecy International Animation Film Festival on June 9, 2025.

metas.name: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Comedy, Sci-Fi, Supernatural Tags:Assassins/Shounen/Male Protagonist/School/Teacher/Guns/Primarily Teen Cast/Super Power A new movie to commemorate Assassination Classroom's 10th anniversary of the TV anime. It adapts episodes previously omitted in the original anime series.

As graduation nears, Class 3-E reflects on their year with Koro Sensei and the lessons he'll leave behind.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Drama, Mecha, Sci-Fi Tags:Terrorism/Military/Real Robot/Male Protagonist/Love Triangle/Politics/Class Struggle/Primarily Adult Cast/Psychosexual Haunted by past trauma, Hathaway is drawn to the mysterious girl Gigi Andalucia, whose strange powers stir memories within him. While swayed by her cryptic words, he continues preparing for Mafty’s mission — the attack on the Adelaide Conference. Meanwhile, Kenneth Sleg of the Federation Forces prepares a defense operation for the Adelaide Conference and a plan to eliminate Mafty, when he is approached by Hundley Yeoksan of the Criminal Police Organization with a secret proposal. As Hathaway and Kenneth pursue their respective goals, Gigi also sets off for Hong Kong to fulfill her own role.

(Source: GundamInfo, edited)

metas.name: Hanarokushou ga Akeru Hi ni
metas.description:
Genres: Drama Tags:Rural/Environmental/Stop Motion/Suicide The Obinata Fireworks Shop factory is getting prepared for an administrative action for confiscation tomorrow. It has been six years since Keitaro has been holed up in a closed-down factory creating fireworks by himself, chasing after an illusion of his father who vanished. It is a story about three young people who overcome the extreme weather conditions, disasters and environmental problems imposed on them and establish their own identities.

(Source: Marché du Film Festival de Cannes)

*The film was selected for the 77th Cannes Film Festival’s 2024 Annecy Animation Showcase.
*Note: Initially slated for a 2025 release, on May 20th of the same year the movie was delayed to 2026.

metas.name: Gintama the Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi Tags:Oiran/Samurai/Found Family/Meta/Swordplay/Male Protagonist/Shounen/Gore/Parody/Historical/Aliens/Orphan/Crossdressing/CGI/Homeless/Police/Gender Bending/Drugs Movie remake of the Yoshiwara Enjou arc.

Upon meeting a young boy named Haruta who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hiwa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Haruta's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

Note: This anime was announced at the "Gintama Multiverse Festival," an event held on August 16th, as part of the "Gintama 20th Anniversary Project." This movie features volumes 25 and 26 of the manga, and the TV anime series spans eight episodes, from episodes 139 to 146.

metas.name: Paris ni Saku Étoile
metas.description:
Genres: Slice of Life, Sports Tags:Female Protagonist/Foreign/Ballet/Historical/Swordplay/War/Drawing "I want to blossom, in this city."

The story follows two Japanese girls who never give up in reaching for étoile (stars) during the difficult times at the start of 20th century. Fujiko, who dreams of becoming a painter, and Chizuru, who is drawn into the world of ballet, meet by chance in Yokohama. Then, as if guided by fate, they meet again in Paris and work hard to follow their dreams together.

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Kusunoki no Bannin
metas.description: Genres: Drama, Mystery, Supernatural Tags:Class Struggle/Environmental/Religion/Urban Fantasy Adaptation of Keigo Hagashino's Kusunoki no Bannin novel about a mysterious camphor tree that is said to grant wishes if you pray to it, and the young man who becomes its guardian.

metas.name: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express – the Movie
metas.description:
Genres: Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi Tags:Female Protagonist/Cyborg/Cyberpunk/Delinquents/Police/Ensemble Cast/Robots/Full CGI/Slapstick/Trains/Space/Artificial Intelligence/Primarily Adult Cast/Crime/Fugitive/Meta Theatrical version of Ginga Tokkyuu Milky☆Subway with additional new scenes.

Six delinquents are tasked with cleaning a train as part of a community service program. But when the train suddenly takes off, chaos ensues.

(Source: Netflix)

metas.name: LABYRINTH
metas.description:
Genres: Horror, Sci-Fi Tags:Female Protagonist/Idol/Isekai/Full CGI/Denpa/Cosmic Horror One day, Shiori Maezawa, an ordinary high school girl, cracked her smartphone while falling down a staircase. As she wakes up, she finds herself in a deserted, parallel world that looks like Yokohama.

When she looks at her smartphone, she finds a photo of herself that she doesn't remember posting on social media. What’s the source of this mysterious post?

Will she be able to escape from this strange smartphone labyrinth?

(Source: Official Site, translated)

metas.name: Doraemon: Shin Nobita no Kaitei Kiganjou
metas.description:
Genres: Fantasy Tags:Primarily Child Cast/Robots/Travel/Shounen 10,000 meters below sea level. On this Earth, there lies a world no one has yet to uncover.

Note: This is a remake of the 1983 movie Doraemon: Nobita no Kaitei Kiganjou.

metas.name: Oshirimae Man: Fukkatsu no Oshirimae Teikoku
metas.description:
Genres: Comedy Tags: Maejiri, an otherwise ordinary office worker whose only unusual trait is that his butt is in the front, secretly lives a double life as the city's protector — Oshirimae Man. One day he discovers that a strange drug is spreading through the city which causes people's butts to move to the front. After infiltrating a pharmaceutical company, he uncovers the shocking "Oshirimae Man Empire Revival Plan," led by a mysterious villain burning with vengeance.

Can Oshirimae Man stop him before all of humanity finds its butt… in the front?

(Source: YouTube, edited)

metas.name: Han ye Deng Zhu
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Sci-Fi Tags: The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A once-thriving film studio faces bankruptcy. The enormous compound, with structures ranging from the Great Sphinx of Giza to the Forbidden City, is now completely covered in snow and stripped of its former glory. Zha, a lonely janitor, tends to this forgotten place, with only a cat that used to perform in films for company. Running out of money, the studio owner gives him a VR headset as partial compensation. Zha is immediately drawn into the virtual world and embarks on a romantic journey with a female player who invites him on a trip to the moon. Meanwhile, the studio, which is about to close permanently, is temporarily brought back to life when a film crew arrives to shoot an alien invasion movie on the expansive backlot – with the studio’s actual destruction slated to be shot as the movie’s final showdown.

(Source: Berlinale Film Festival)

metas.name: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc-
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Romance, Sci-Fi, Supernatural Tags:Magic/Male Protagonist The invitation has arrived. It is time for the New Year’s Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as the successor, she would never have to see her brother live as a pariah ever again. At the same time, such a position surely entails a political marriage, plunging her mind into complete turmoil. Complicating matters, the current head of their family sows doubt with the shocking claim that Miyuki is not Tatsuya’s sister. When the new year comes, their relationship may be changed forever...

(Source: Yen Press)

metas.name: Mononoke The Movie: Chapter Ⅲ - The Curse of the Serpent
metas.description: Genres: Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural Tags:Youkai/Exorcism/Royal Affairs/Revenge/Historical/Primarily Adult Cast/Male Protagonist/Henshin/Tanned Skin/Ojou-sama/Cosmic Horror The third movie in the Mononoke movie trilogy.

metas.name: Saishuu Gakushou Hibike! Euphonium - Zenpen
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Music, Slice of Life Tags:Female Protagonist/Bisexual/LGBTQ+ Themes/Band/School Club/Classical Music/Coming of Age/School/Primarily Teen Cast/Primarily Female Cast The music isn’t over yet!

“Sound! Euphonium, The Final Movie” is coming in 2026!

metas.name: Love Live! Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club: Bloom Garden Party
metas.description:
Genres: Music, Slice of Life Tags:Idol/Full CGI/Primarily Female Cast/Female Protagonist/Dancing/Ensemble Cast/Cute Girls Doing Cute Things/School The Bloom Garden Party is finally here. It’s the stage where everyone will “someday, surely” bloom—the goal Kaho and the others have been chasing for a whole year. This is the first step.

The long-awaited day has finally arrived — the day when the promise they made with the graduates will come true. It was also the last day for the 103rd-year students, on the verge of graduation, could spend with their friends as students of Hasunosora.

―Even so, the girls race through their “youth” with all their might. This is the story of girls who struggled to bloom, a tale of dreams made real together.

(Source: Love Live! Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club: Bloom Garden Party Site, translated)

metas.name: Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway
metas.description:
Genres: Mystery Tags:Motorcycles/Detective/Crime/Police/Artificial Intelligence Conan, Ran, Sonoko, and Kogoro were heading to Yokohama's Minato Mirai district with motorcycle enthusiast Masumi Sera for the Kanagawa Motorcycle Festival. Then, a mysterious black motorcycle appeared, leaping over the car carrying Conan and the others. And chasing it was Chihaya Hagiwara of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police Traffic Mobile Unit—the “Goddess of the Wind” Ran had once seen. However, after a fierce car chase, Chihaya's motorcycle was wrecked, and she let the target slip away at the last moment. After arriving at the Yokohama festival venue, Conan and the others witnessed the unveiling of a new police motorcycle equipped with cutting-edge technology, named "Angel." Amidst this, reports surfaced that a runaway "black motorcycle" had now appeared in central Tokyo, evading pursuit by the Metropolitan Police Department. The purpose of the rampage remains unknown, but the vehicle's body bears a striking resemblance to "Angel." Police have dubbed the black Angel bike "Lucifer" and continue their pursuit.

(Source: Official website, translated)

metas.name: Shin Keroro Gunsou Movie: Fukkatsushite Sokkou Chikyuu Metsubou no Kiki de Arimasu!
metas.description:
Genres: Comedy, Sci-Fi Tags: The Keroro Platoon, living their lazy days as if invasion were nothing. Then one day, they face a series of bizarre phenomena erupting across the nation. Feeling a sense of crisis, the Keroro Platoon rises up, staking their pride as invaders! What is the meaning of the mysterious symbols they encounter wherever they go. The largest-scale battle in the history of "Sgt.Frog" begins in the Reiwa era!

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

Note: Relations are provisional and will be updated when more info is announced.

metas.name: Chimney Town: Frozen in Time
metas.description:
Genres: Fantasy Tags: Sequel to Entotsu-machi no Poupelle.

After losing his friend Poupelle, young Lubicchi wanders into a mysterious realm where a clock in a tower is frozen at 11:59. To return home, he must restart it – and find the courage to believe again.

(Source: Berlin International Film Festival)

metas.name: Himitsu no AiPri: Mankai Buzzrium Live!
metas.description: Genres: Music Tags: Movie of Himitsu no AiPri, first announced at the Pretty Series Crossing Live 2025.

metas.name: Eri
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Romance, Sci-Fi
Tags:Primarily Animal Cast
In a world where cows that do not bear calves cannot remain, Eri, a Holstein cow, falls in love with another female. Her sighs linger through sleepless nights — will they find their way to the one she loves? Based on Kasumi Asakura's novel “Who Else Is There?” (2008, Gentosha Inc.)

metas.name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
metas.description:
Genres: Mahou Shoujo Tags:Magic/Female Protagonist/Primarily Female Cast/Philosophy/Witch/Gods/Super Power/Urban Fantasy/Demons/Kuudere/Guns/Curses The 10th anniversary online event for the Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica anime revealed that the franchise is getting a new anime film titled Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten. The film will be an official sequel to the Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica: Hangyaku no Monogatari film that opened in October 2013. The tagline on the new film's visual reads, "Now, let's continue the story."

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

metas.name: THE RIBBON HERO
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Fantasy, Mahou Shoujo Tags:Female Protagonist/Superhero/Henshin/Shoujo/Swordplay/Medieval/Fairy Tale/Magic/LGBTQ+ Themes/Femboy/Cyborg/Crossdressing/Tomboy/Royal Affairs Princess Sapphire of the lost kingdom. Stripped of everything in her homeland, Silverland, by the calamity known as "Nergal," she arrived in Goldland at the very depths of despair. While carrying the weight of her past, she began to find a glimmer of hope through the kindness of the people. Yet, as if mocking her peaceful daily life, the calamity "Nergal" appears once more. The same despair that reduced her homeland to ashes is now threatening to steal the light from this land as well.

"No more loss for me. No more loss for anyone.”

Wiping way her fears of sorrow, the young girl takes up her sword.
This is the story of a hero who ties her ribbon and resolves to defy fate.

(Source: THE RIBBON HERO Official Site)

Note: This anime is inspired by Osamu Tezuka's manga "Princess Knight”.

metas.name: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: CLOUDY BEACH
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Drama, Mystery, Thriller Tags:Death Game/Female Protagonist/Primarily Female Cast/Survival/Coastal/Wilderness/Yuri/Seinen/LGBTQ+ Themes Theatrical follow-up to Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.

This is a story about a deranged world.

Player name: Yuuki. Occupation: Professional death game player.
Having overcome the jinx known as the "Wall of Thirty," which drastically reduces the survival rates of players, Yuuki continues her journey.
Games where death is always close at hand. Her next challenge is on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. There, eight players have gathered. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows.
The game – "Cloudy Beach."

Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she will play death games to put food on the table.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

metas.name: Unanswered//butterfly: Sword Art Online
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Adventure Tags:Full CGI/Rural/Primarily Teen Cast/Female Protagonist/Swordplay/Virtual World/Medieval The world’s first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality.

Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman.

Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

(Source: Official Site, translated)

Note: Released as part of the Echoes of Aincrad: Sword Art Online's game limited edition.

metas.name: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
metas.description:
Genres: Romance Tags:Heterosexual The story centers on two Tokyo high schoolers who connect over a painting of fireworks. They trace the painting to the Nagaoka Fireworks Festival in Niigata, one of Japan's three major fireworks festivals, and to a mysterious promise that connects the two to the past.

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

metas.name: Wareware wa Uchuujin
metas.description:
Genres: Drama Tags:Coming of Age/Rotoscoping One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Kyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart. Spanning more than thirty years, this gentle, contemplative story invites the audience to reflect on the meaning of life through the paths their lives take.

(Source: NOTHING NEW)

metas.name: Saishuu Gakushou Hibike! Euphonium - Kouhen
metas.description: Genres: Drama, Music, Slice of Life Tags: Sequel to Saishuu Gakushou Hibike! Euphonium - Zenpen.

metas.name: Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu
metas.description:
Genres: Comedy, Slice of Life Tags:Philosophy/Surreal Comedy/Mermaid/Primarily Animal Cast/Animals/Agender/Coastal/Bisexual Based on a series of Chiikawa comics posted on X by Nagano from March to November 2023, known as the "Siren Arc".

One day, while Chiikawa and Hachiware were relaxing in the square, Usagi suddenly appeared with a flyer stuck to its face. When Hachiware checked the flyer, it was an invitation reading “Special Invitation to a Special Island.”

Lured by promises like “Get 100x rewards for simple island quests!” and “Limited-edition island ramen, exclusive sweets—sweet and spicy treats all practically free!”, Chiikawa and the others decided to go on the island retreat. Boarding the ship alongside Rakko, who was suspicious of the flyer's contents, the group landed on the island... only to find something waiting for them there...!?

(Source: Official Site, translated)

metas.name: Shiranuhi
metas.description:
Genres: Supernatural Tags:Coastal The short is set in a coastal town in Kumamoto at the tail end of summer 1996. The 10-year-old boy Minato lives a precarious life with his drunkard father. Minato's only source of strength is Ben-chan, a goddess in the form of a young girl that appeared in Benten Island. The time he spends with her are the only times where he feels like himself. But when he is about to be separated from Ben-chan due to being sent to a children's home, Minato prays to a Shiranuhi, a mysterious light floating above the sea, to grant him one wish. His wish, filled with hatred towards his father, eventually becomes a curse.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Initially teased at AnimeJapan 2024 in the CoMix Wave Films booth, a visual of this project was shown off with a description being a new animation project by a "rookie director".

metas.name: Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu
metas.description: Genres: Mahou Shoujo Tags:Henshin/Primarily Female Cast/Kids Movie of Meitantei Precure!.

metas.name: Majo no Tani no Yoru
metas.description:
Genres: Fantasy Tags: A short film only screened at the Cinema Orion at Ghibli Park in Nagakute.

The film is set in Ghibli Park's "Valley of the Witches" and is the first original animated short film created by Studio Ghibli for Ghibli Park.

metas.name: Crayon Shin-chan: Kikikaikai! Ora no Youkai Vacation
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy Tags:Kids The Nohara family go to Hiroshi's hometown of Akita to attend a famous fireworks festival during the summer. However, an incident causes youkai to escape from their land and will wreak havoc in Akita and in other areas throughout Japan. The Nohara family then go to the land of youkai and find themselves in a mysterious yet nostalgic world, where they go on an unpredictable adventure.

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Dust of the Simulacrum
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Sci-Fi Tags:Full CGI A young girl arrives of the surface of a harsh and dangerous world. There she meets a boy prepared to confront those dangers. Each is there with a purpose, as the world around them gradually falls apart, atom by atom—or rather, datum by datum.

(Source: Fantasia Festival)

metas.name: Echo
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Fantasy Tags:Twins Among a primordial ocean of stars, two innocent, identical children share a vessel. It comes to ground on a strange, liminal world, where a mischievous spirit appears, announcing itself as their guide on the nine-month journey ahead of them. Here in the world we know, meanwhile, a bereaved and pregnant woman struggles with grief and terrible uncertainty.

(Source: Fantasia Festival)

Note: Originally released on March 6, 2026 as a part of "Gemnibus Vol. 2" anthology, however was also simultaneously selected to screen, and then later premiered at Fantasia International Film Festival.

metas.name: Rusuban
metas.description:
Genres: Slice of Life Tags: Set in August 1987, the story follows one day in the life of Tokko as she stays at home in a large house while her family is away.

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Soreike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi
metas.description:
Genres: Comedy, Fantasy Tags: Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.

(Source: Anime News Network)

metas.name: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi
metas.description: Genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Sci-Fi Tags:Travel/Survival/Chibi/Curses/Seinen/Primarily Child Cast/Male Protagonist/Gore/Female Protagonist/Monster Girl/Lost Civilization Sequel to Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou.

metas.name: Witch on the Holy Night
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy Tags:Magic/Urban Fantasy/Witch/Urban/Female Protagonist/Kuudere/Fairy Tale/School/Ensemble Cast/Male Protagonist/Philosophy/Robots/Werewolf Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...

The girl meets a boy.

This is the beginning of one young girl’s story — the tale of a Witch.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural Tags:Male Protagonist/Female Protagonist/Coming of Age/Heterosexual/Primarily Adult Cast/College/Urban/Urban Fantasy "Actually, I’m Touko Kirishima."

The audience erupted in excitement upon learning that the true identity of the mysterious, wildly popular internet singer was none other than the nation’s favorite actress, Mai Sakurajima. The scene was exactly the same as the dream Sakuta Azusagawa had seen on Christmas Eve.

Starting with Mai’s shocking confession on April 1, the impossible events that everyone once dreamed of keep happening one after another. The social media hashtag "#Yumemiru," where dreams come true, has vanished, and as Sakuta struggles with the disconnect between the reality before him and his own perception, he receives a message from a version of himself in an alternate reality.

―Stop Touko Kirishima,
―Before reality is rewritten.

To restore the world to its original state, Sakuta sets out to find Touko Kirishima. This is a story about overcoming the "Adolescent Syndrome".

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

metas.name: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Mystery Tags:Female Protagonist/Medicine/Politics/Seinen/Ancient China/Historical The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water.

The emperor gives Jinshi an order. He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they’re in pristine condition. She’s beautiful, as if she were still alive. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan.

They arrive at a bustling city on the water. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away.

“I hope nothing happens...”

Jinshi’s premonition comes true. On the day of the concubine’s funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: GROTESQQQUE
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Supernatural Tags:Anthology/Found Family/Gyaru/Vampire/Aliens/Video Games/Monster Girl/Female Protagonist/Post-Apocalyptic/Yuri/Battle Royale/Survival/Virtual World/LGBTQ+ Themes/Cohabitation/Motorcycles/Primarily Female Cast/Cute Girls Doing Cute Things/Kemonomimi Anthology movie consisting of three original animation segments:

Q1 - ÆLIENS (エリィアンズ)
Earth has entered an age of interplanetary exchange.
As fear and prejudice toward aliens spread across society, a young alien girl named Elie arrives as an interstellar goodwill ambassador. She adores Earth’s culture and its wonderfully pointless everyday life, and teams up with Kento Kunikura, a civil servant who works for the Space Bureau, to search for “friends” across the planet.

But Elie’s powers sometimes spiral out of control. As a mysterious alien surrounded by secrets, she soon attracts public attention and suspicion, and people gradually begin to see her as an “invader.”

Then, without warning, hostile aliens appear──!?

Q2 - Yoroshiku★Shoujo (夜露死駆★少女)
In the city of GALs TOKYO, morning never comes.
Every night, girls known as “Gal Ps” gather there—girls who no longer have a place for themselves in the real world.

They all seek the same goal: to become the ultimate victor in a game called Queen of Butterfly, or QoB for short, and claim the title of “Queen.”

A truant girl named STELLA hears rumors of an urban legend and throws herself into the deadly game. Girls kill and fall, scattering like butterflies in the night. In the middle of the chaos, STELLA encounters a mysterious girl carrying an SSS-ranked weapon and wielding overwhelming power. Through her, STELLA uncovers the hidden truth behind the game──

Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni (ノクターン～このグロテスクな夜に～)
In a world where humanity has already perished, a pureblood vampire named Ayame travels in a wagon car alongside three girls who survived by becoming “infected” through her blood.
Above them, countless stars light up the night like daylight, while golden fields shimmer across the ruined earth. Through a vampire’s eyes, even a devastated world can look breathtakingly beautiful.
Together, the girls cherish the small, quiet moments of life left behind in this empty world.

“Even if a vampire’s body perishes, the soul never disappears.”
When Ayame quietly speaks those words, Shion senses the loneliness and despair hidden within someone doomed to live forever.

Then one day, something strange begins to happen to Ayame, and the girls’ unchanging everyday life slowly starts to crack apart.

(Souce: Aniplex USA)
